title: Read-in personnel dig into the program's historical backlog and get into trouble
summary: Dylan Borland tells of Read-in personnel dig into the program's historical backlog and get into trouble, about 2010s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: but there is a at least in their instance a historical backlog that once they were read in they went and began to dig into and that's when those individuals began to get into trouble.

plain: Dylan Borland, a man who says a top government official told him that aliens run everything, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about people in a secret programme in the 2010s. He says that once some people were "read in", meaning formally given access to the secret, they began digging into the programme's backlog of older history, and that is when they got into trouble. If true, it would mean the programme's past is guarded even from its own members.
